verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships FIDO2 (which includes device attestation) and PIV, but there is no documentation of an attestation verification workflow for registration, and a hands-on report notes attestation certificates can't be exported via standard PKCS#11 and require a custom vendor tool plus a non-standard ASN.1 cert format, adding real friction for engineers building attestation checks. missing for 10: first-party docs on attestation cert format/verification API, standard PKCS#11/FIDO2 attestation export support, independent confirmation of a smooth registration-time attestation check.
